name: perch
description: Perch — a local-first project command center for developers managing many software projects.

scripts.setup: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run db:seed && next build
scripts.build:app: npm run rebuild:node && next build && npm run rebuild:electron && node scripts/prepare-server.mjs && npm run rebuild:node
scripts.package: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:app && electron-builder --mac --win; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.package:mac: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:app && electron-builder --mac; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.package:win: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:app && electron-builder --win; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.package:linux: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:app && electron-builder --linux; npm run rebuild:node
scripts.release: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:app && electron-builder --mac --win --publish always; npm run rebuild:node
